9. Kharassarajātaka The Harsh Sound: a past life story

“Yato viluttā ca hatā ca gāvo, When cows were plundered and killed, Daḍḍhāni gehāni jano ca nīto; houses burned down, and people abducted, Athāgamā puttahatāya putto, then came the son of she whose son is dead, Kharassaraṁ ḍiṇḍimaṁ vādayanto”ti. sounding the harsh drum of war.

Kharassarajātakaṁ navamaṁ.
